findings.title: Restore reads and deletes the .full.md backup without checking it against protected/excluded paths
findings.x-resolution: T031: both actions protect backups before reads/mutations. Six exact-code modes cover cross-baton read_first/hash, managed, excluded existing/absent and case-aliased backups; invalid excluded bytes are not decoded.
findings.reason: Executable guard violates FR-007/FR-009 and the cross-baton protection edge case: a hash-bound or read_first backup is consumed and removed.
findings.x-evidence: L233 checks only the target against protection.protectedPaths. backupPath (L252-253) is never checked; restore reads it (L264) and rm(backup) at L290. Adversarial reproduction: another feature's handoff binding specs/002-draft/spec.full.md with its sha256; restore preview allowed:true, apply exit 0, backup deleted, then context scope for that feature fails 'Required context source is missing'. Security reviewer independently raised the same gap.
findings.x-fix: Refuse compact and restore (preview reason and apply) when key(backupPath) is in protectedPaths or excludedPaths; add an integration case where another baton binds the backup.
findings.x-rereview: backup protection evaluated before reads; exclusion/case-alias/managed/hash/read_first refusal tests pass (canonical spellings only, see F22)

findings.title: Restore without backup: preview reports allowed and apply leaks raw ENOENT as E_INTERNAL exit 10
findings.x-resolution: T032: preview reports missing backup with allowed:false; apply returns E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED and the relative backup path, with unchanged snapshots.
findings.reason: contracts/context.md requires an existing backup and repository-standard diagnostics naming target/reason.
findings.x-evidence: Preview returns at L246 before any backup check; restore branch calls readFile(backup) unguarded, so ENOENT reaches cli.mjs:68-74 as E_INTERNAL with an absolute path. Compact branch uses optionalBytes and a typed E_CONFLICT. Correctness and adversarial agree; adversarial reproduced exit 10.
findings.x-fix: Check optionalBytes(root, backupPath) for restore before building the report; add a preview reason and throw a typed BatonError with the relative backup path on apply; add a regression test.

findings.title: Non-canonical do_not_read spellings bypass exclusion and backup protection
findings.reason: key() only folds separators and case, and contextExcluded compares raw strings, while the handoff path schema allows ./, /./ and // segments. Schema-valid exclusions of spec.full.md as ./specs/x/spec.full.md, specs/x/./spec.full.md or specs//x/spec.full.md let restore --apply overwrite the target with excluded content and delete the backup; ./ exclusion of the target let compact apply. Violates FR-007..FR-010 and the spec edge case that aliases must not evade protection.
findings.x-evidence: Independent temp-repo probe at a4e3277: canonical spelling -> E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED; three non-canonical spellings -> exit 0, applied:true, target replaced, backup deleted; ./ target exclusion -> compact applied.
findings.x-fix: Canonicalize all protection/exclusion/read_first/artifact keys (collapse ./ and empty segments, POSIX-normalize, then case-fold) or reject non-canonical metadata paths fail-closed; add refusal tests for each spelling for target, backup and candidate.
findings.x-resolution: T039: key() POSIX-normalizes separators/dot segments before case folding and rejects normalized repository roots, traversal, absolute paths and colon aliases. Eighteen schema-valid alias cases exercise cross-feature excluded targets/backups/candidates, read_first/artifacts and managed paths; strict filesystem reads still fail closed on noncanonical required sources. Excluded backup/candidate fixtures contain invalid UTF-8 to prove they are not decoded. Three root spellings are refused. Preview/apply exact codes and unchanged snapshots are asserted.

findings.title: Restore apply does not bind the previewed backup digest
findings.reason: The limitation is real but an expected-backup reservation is outside the approved contract: contracts/context.md Guarded Writer binds --expect to the original target only, and plan.md Implementation Design explicitly avoids new concurrent-writer protocols and excludes arbitrary external writers. T040 now requires surfacing warning/backup_sha256 and re-previewing before explicit apply, and documents that the backup digest is informational, not provenance or a cross-call freshness guarantee. Within-apply backup snapshot checks remain enforced. Adding a mandatory --expect-backup protocol needs separate scope approval; this disposition does not claim that cross-call backup replacement is detected.
findings.x-fix: Require and verify an expected backup digest for restore apply (e.g. --expect-backup) and test a swapped backup.

findings.title: Compact preview without --candidate reports allowed:true but apply fails E_USAGE
findings.reason: Approved contracts/context.md explicitly defines a non-mutating eligibility/preview report and makes candidate/expect mandatory for apply, not for eligibility preview. The compact wrapper intentionally checks eligibility before generating the candidate. Treating a missing candidate as ineligible would contradict that flow. T040 clarifies that allowed does not waive apply prerequisites; existing exact E_USAGE tests retain their enforcement.

findings.title: Restore/compact wrappers do not tell agents to surface warning/backup_sha256 or distinguish E_CONFLICT causes
findings.reason: Add wrapper guidance to show warning and backup digest before apply and to report conflict cause.
findings.x-resolution: T040: authored restore guidance surfaces warning/backup_path/backup_sha256 and overwrite, removal, provenance and freshness limits. Both wrappers report exact E_CONFLICT causes without deleting backups or silently substituting digests. Normal sync regenerates matching authored pack copies; all locked upstream hashes and pins remain unchanged. A registered context output regression checks this guidance and generated-copy equality.

findings.title: Unreachable missing-backup throw after reasons gate
findings.reason: The local null guard intentionally narrows Buffer|null for type-safe restore assignment and preserves the exact protected diagnostic if preflight changes. Earlier string reasons do not narrow backupBytes for TypeScript. Removing it would require an unsafe assertion or an unnecessary control-flow abstraction; missing-backup preview/apply contracts remain tested.

findings.title: Backup conflict uses a separate reason channel from reasons[]
findings.reason: The separate boolean preserves distinct public diagnostics: protected eligibility failures are E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED/exit 1, while an existing backup is E_CONFLICT/exit 4. Preview merges the conflict into reasons without mutating protection reasons. A typed reason framework or message matching would add complexity without a behavioral fix; T041 asserts both exact outcomes and no writes.
